hooks.command: AGENTSTOZ_PROJECT_MEMORY_ACTIVITY=codex; WORKING_ROOT="$(pwd -P)"; PROJECT_TOP="$(git -C "$WORKING_ROOT" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"; MEMORY_SUBPATH=''; MEMORY_ROOT="$WORKING_ROOT"; if [ -n "$PROJECT_TOP" ]; then MAIN_TOP="$(git -C "$PROJECT_TOP" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | head -n 1)"; [ -n "$MAIN_TOP" ] || { cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; exit 0; }; MEMORY_ROOT="$MAIN_TOP"; [ -z "$MEMORY_SUBPATH" ] || MEMORY_ROOT="$MAIN_TOP/$MEMORY_SUBPATH"; fi; if [ ! -f "$MEMORY_ROOT/.agent-memory/config.json" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; exit 0; fi; hook="$MEMORY_ROOT/.agent-memory/activity-hook.sh"; if [ -f "$hook" ]; then /bin/sh "$hook" codex; else cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
